title: pvAppendAttributes
body:
## pvAppendAttributes

Combines the point and cell arrays of several inputs that share the same geometry: the output copies the first input's geometry and adds every array from all inputs. Inputs whose point or cell count differs from the first are ignored for that attribute type, and a repeated array name gets the suffix _input_<n>. Use it to gather fields computed on separate branches of one mesh (e.g. gradient and cellSize results) into one node; use append or pvAppendDatasets to join different meshes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only counts are checked, not point order or coordinates; inputs from differently numbered meshes silently attach values to the wrong points.
- Duplicate array names are renamed, not replaced; check names before later nodes refer to them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendAttributes`. Identity: `filters/AppendAttributes`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Append Attributes filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.

```json

  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendAttributes",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
